_comment: Turkish translation memory for per-token i'rab notes. Keyed by the English i'rab string exactly as authored in chapters/*.json. tools/build_prototype.py merges these into each token's irab object at build time, so a phrase is translated once and every story reusing it gets Turkish for free. Terminology follows Turkish madrasah usage (fi'l-i mazi, fâil, mef'ûlün bih, muzâfun ileyh, harf-i cer, ...). Run tools/check_irab_tr.py to list untranslated strings.
